title: Onboarding Snapshot: Compact Hosted API Quicklaunch Canvas
creator: Clara Nguyen
description: Create a compact, single-screen focused suite of getting-started screenshots and micro-animations for the Hosted API quickstart. The goal is a "mini-canvas" that combines: model selection, a lightweight request-builder ("Mini-Composer"), a live code snippet panel (JS / Python / cURL) and a streaming response preview that highlights the EventSource/streaming integration. Visuals should support both light and dark modes and include small callouts for key concepts: model affinity badges, inferred token cost, and whether prefix/KV cache is being used. These assets will be used in docs, the quickstart modal inside the Console, and marketing one-pagers for the March release.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver 6 high-resolution PNG screenshots: model-select, mini-composer-empty, mini-composer-filled, streaming-preview, SDK-code-split-view, error-state
Include 3 short animated GIFs (streaming tokens, model selection micro-interaction, request-builder autofill)
Design notes + copy finalized and approved by PM
Figma file exported with slices and redwood tokens; images uploaded to Drive folder and referenced in docs PR
Dev handoff doc with exact breakpoint specs and component states
